extracted.intended_audience: Authors preparing AMS-LaTeX files for submission to the American Mathematical Society (AMS) for publication
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for authors on preparing manuscripts (journal articles, memoirs, monographs/textbooks, proceedings articles) in AMS-LaTeX for submission to the AMS, including required document structure, formatting, and submission checklist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handbook versions by manuscript type
rubrics_metrics.description: There are four versions of the handbook, depending on the nature of the manuscript: Journal articles; Memoirs (although distributed as a journal, Memoirs has special formatting requirements); Monographs and textbooks; Articles for proceedings volumes or other collections.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The appropriate version is bundled into every author package, but a PDF copy can also be downloaded.
